title: FutureSafe
tagline: TimeSafe is a blockchain-based platform that allows individuals to create & store digital time capsules which can include msgs, photos, documents etc. & are locked for a specified period.It ensures that only the intended recipients can open the capsule when the time is right.
description:
In today’s fast-paced digital world, we are constantly capturing memories — through photos, videos, voice notes, and more — but how often do we revisit them? How often do we take a moment to reflect on those memories, and how often are they shared in meaningful, thoughtful ways?

Too often, our digital content is scattered across multiple platforms, or it gets lost in the shuffle of everyday life. And while social media allows for instant sharing, there’s little room for anticipation, for curation, for the excitement of unveiling a memory at the perfect time.

What if we could be more intentional about how we share our stories and leave behind something truly lasting, personal, and valuable? 
[Solution: TimeSafe]

This is where TimeSafe comes in.

With TimeSafe, users can create time capsules—digital containers filled with memories, whether it’s a heartfelt letter, a collection of photos, videos, voice messages, or even a combination of all. What makes it extraordinary is the ability to set an unlock date, a future moment when the contents of the capsule can be revealed to its recipient.

Let’s say you want to preserve a message for your child on their 18th birthday, or leave a video for your best friend on their wedding day, or even write a letter to your future self to be opened 10 years from now. TimeSafe makes this possible.

The workflow is simple yet powerful:

Add Content: First, you’ll curate the content. This can be photos, videos, letters, or anything that encapsulates the memory you want to preserve. Whether it's a voice recording of your thoughts on an important day or a video montage from a family vacation, the choice is yours.

Add Unlock Date: Next, you select the unlock date. This could be next week, next year, or even in 50 years. Maybe it’s your daughter’s wedding day, or the anniversary of a special event. The beauty is in the flexibility — you control the timeline.

Add Recipient: You’ll then add the recipient. This could be a family member, a friend, or even yourself. You can also add multiple recipients, so no one misses out on the moment.

Personalize It: Finally, you can add a personalized message, writing down the memories, emotions, and significance behind the capsule. This adds a deeply personal touch, ensuring that the recipient not only receives the content but also the heartfelt story behind it.
